news.title: Cabinet postpones November 5 electricity session
news.summary: The Cabinet Secretariat announced on November 4 that the session scheduled for November 5 would move to the following week. Its signed agenda identifies electricity as the session’s subject. The postponement notice specifies neither a replacement date nor a reason.
news.significance: Analysis: the delay shifts the next opportunity for Cabinet consideration of the electricity file. Investors and operators should await a dated replacement agenda and published decisions before treating discussions as approvals.
